description: Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto. Coverage: Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Kevyen liikenteen väylät 2013; Nannut satamaraportit 2000-2011; Lounais-Suomen rautatiet; Turun keskusta-alueen julkiset pyöräpysäkit (yksityisillä mailla) 2020. Formats seen: WMS, CSV, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
